title: Auth Streamlining: Remove CLI Dependencies
prompt: Remove hard dependencies on `claude`, `gh`, and `jira` CLI tools so users can go from app install to fully working without any prerequisite setup steps. Implement in-app auth flows for GitHub (OAuth App + PKCE + Octokit) and Jira (API token + REST), verify/use SDK-bundled Claude binary, and add a first-run setup wizard.

steps.title: Verify Agent SDK binary bundling
steps.summary: Check if @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk ships a bundled claude binary as an optional dependency and confirm Electron packaging includes it.
steps.instructions: Inspect node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/ for a bundled claude binary (look for bin/, dist/, or platform-specific optional packages). Check electron-builder / electron-vite config to confirm optional dependencies are included in the build. If the binary is present, update agent.ts so that when claude is not found in PATH it falls back to the SDK-bundled binary path using require.resolve. If absent, surface a clear error to the renderer rather than silently failing.

steps.title: Simplify Claude auth: API key only
steps.summary: Remove the claude login OAuth subprocess fallback — API key is now the only valid Agent SDK auth path as of Feb 2026.
steps.instructions: In secrets.ts, remove the CLI OAuth fallback from resolveClaudeAuth() so it only returns the API key path. If keytar returns no key, block session creation with a clear actionable error ('Add your Anthropic API key in Settings → Claude'). In the Claude settings panel, add a direct link to console.anthropic.com/settings/keys and a live validation step (fire models.list() against the Anthropic SDK on key entry, show green/red status indicator).

steps.title: First-run setup wizard
steps.summary: Add a SetupWizard.vue shown on first launch that checks each service's auth state and walks the user through setup.
steps.instructions: Add a setupState IPC channel in ipc.ts that returns { claude: { ready, mode }, github: { ready, mode }, jira: { ready, mode } }. Create SetupWizard.vue — shown on first launch or when any service is not ready — with a step per service showing status and a single action (enter key, Connect, etc.). Store a setupComplete flag in user-data so the wizard is skipped on subsequent launches. Add a 'Connection Status' entry in SettingsView that re-runs the check on demand. Wire the IPC channel through shared/ipc-contract.ts and preload/index.ts.

steps.title: GitHub: OAuth App + PKCE in-app flow
steps.summary: Register a GitHub OAuth App, implement PKCE browser flow with agentkeeper:// deep link, store token in keytar.
steps.instructions: Register an Agentkeeper GitHub OAuth App (public client, PKCE, callback: agentkeeper://oauth/github). Register the agentkeeper:// custom URL scheme in electron-builder config (protocols field) and handle it in main/index.ts via app.setAsDefaultProtocolClient. Implement a PKCE helper in main/auth/github.ts: generate code_verifier + code_challenge, open github.com/login/oauth/authorize via shell.openExternal, receive the redirect on the custom scheme, extract code, exchange code + code_verifier for an access token (no client secret needed), store in keytar under plugin:github:access_token. Add github.auth IPC methods (connect, disconnect, status) wired through ipc-contract.ts and preload. Update GitHubSettingsPanel.vue with a 'Connect GitHub' button and SSO note (link to github.com/settings/connections/applications if 403 with org scope error).

steps.title: Jira: API token credentials UI
steps.summary: Collect email + instance URL + API token in settings, store token in keytar, validate with a live REST call.
steps.instructions: Extend Jira plugin KV store with email and instanceUrl fields. Store apiToken in keytar under plugin:jira:api_token (not in the KV file). Update JiraSettingsModal.vue to collect all three fields with a direct link to id.atlassian.net/manage/api-tokens. Add a 'Test connection' button that fires GET /rest/api/2/myself and shows the authenticated user display name on success. Update plugin health-check in packages/plugin-jira/src/index.ts: healthy when all three credentials are present in keytar/KV (remove the jira binary poll).

steps.title: GitHub: replace gh CLI with Octokit
steps.summary: Rewrite github-cli.ts using @octokit/rest; remove all gh subprocess calls; update plugin activation to use stored token.
steps.instructions: Add @octokit/rest to packages/plugin-github. Write github-api.ts replacing github-cli.ts: listPRs → octokit.pulls.list(), getPR → octokit.pulls.get(), getPRDiff → octokit.pulls.get({ mediaType: { format: 'diff' } }), getComments → octokit.issues.listComments(), createReview → octokit.pulls.createReview(), mergePR → octokit.pulls.merge(). Update plugin activation in index.ts to read the token from keytar and construct Octokit({ auth: token }). Remove the gh binary health-check poll — plugin is healthy when keytar token is present. Run typecheck and ensure no regressions in the GitHub PR views.

steps.title: Jira: replace jira CLI with REST API
steps.summary: Rewrite jira-cli.ts using direct Atlassian REST v2 calls authenticated with the stored API token.
steps.instructions: Write jira-api.ts replacing jira-cli.ts. Use native fetch (Node 18+) with Basic auth header btoa(email:token) and instanceUrl from KV store. Replace each jira CLI call: project list → GET /rest/api/2/project/search, issue list → GET /rest/api/2/search (JQL), issue view → GET /rest/api/2/issue/{id}, issue create → POST /rest/api/2/issue, issue move → GET /rest/api/2/issue/{id}/transitions then POST /rest/api/2/issue/{id}/transitions, comment add → POST /rest/api/2/issue/{id}/comment. Update index.ts to read credentials from keytar and pass them into jira-api.ts. Remove jira binary health-check poll. Run typecheck and verify Jira issue views still work end-to-end.
